correctness.rationale: An 2026 §2 proves the reduced Świątkowski model computes the target unordered configuration homology. In degree d and weight four, the explicitly enumerated bases have sizes 8855,47740,89460,68120,17461. Exact binary Gaussian rank calculations give d1=8854,d2=38873,d3=50306,d4=17461, hence dimensions 1,13,281,353,0. A standalone complete exhaustive standard-library program recomputes all ranks using either first or last incident reference edges and checks d∘d=0 for all higher-degree basis cells. Gal Euler series independently yields -84. No unproved infinite extension is asserted.

value.rationale: The specific graph K5,4 is the m=4,r=1 case of the explicit still-open family in An 2026 Question 8.1, and (as K4,5) the minimal host of three-particle degree-two odd torsion. The exact field-valued dimensions 281 and 353 separate previously unknown middle-degree contributions for four particles and give a targeted test benchmark for computing free ranks and 2-primary multiplicities. Known top-group, H1 and Euler data are insufficient to infer both. The result is a motivated self-contained finite fact, not an unsupported resolution of the integral or full-family questions.
